faq.question: When should couples book wedding coverage?
faq.answer: Six to twelve months ahead is ideal for popular dates. The inquiry flow captures date and venue first so availability can be checked quickly.

faq.question: When is the best time for maternity portraits?
faq.answer: Most maternity sessions work well around weeks 28-34, when the shape is visible but the session can still feel comfortable.

faq.question: Can this become a real studio booking system?
faq.answer: Yes. The current demo captures local inquiries; P2-11 can move those leads into FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Admin Console status management.
